profile.headline: Chief Software Engineer @ Chivari | Developing Innovative Software Solutions
profile.summary:
As Chief Software Engineer at Chivari, I contribute to the development of innovative, scalable, and user-friendly software systems. With over 23 years of experience in web development and enterprise architecture, my work is grounded in leveraging advanced technologies like Angular, TypeScript, and Angular Material to create impactful solutions for businesses.  

My career has been driven by a commitment to addressing complex technical challenges while enabling teams to deliver high-quality results. By integrating technical expertise and leadership, I strive to build systems that not only meet business needs but also create lasting value for stakeholders.

positions.description: Skills: Angular · .NET · C# · TypeScript · Angular CLI · Architecture · Microsoft Azure · Azure DevOps Services · Azure Data Factory · Azure Functions · Angular Material · SQL

positions.description: Building a new CRM for a niche market in the Medical Billing Arena using Angular and MS Stack.

positions.description: Skills: C# · Entity Framework · Technical Requirements · Agile Methodologies · SQL · Architectural Design · Architecture

Managing a small team of about 13 .NET developers and about 10 different WebSites.

Managing over 5 terrabytes of databases.

positions.title: Vertex Specialist / PL-SQL Tuner

positions.title: Senior Application Developer R&D
positions.description: Working in the Research and Development team, we spent a great deal of time coming up with new applications.  We were responsible for determining the next technological advancements that the company would undertake.
